description: Bulk-import holdings snapshots (rows[] or csv_text). Every row needs a provider (except a provision) and a ticker (except what is owed: mortgage, debt, provision, where quantity is the amount owed and is stored negative) (POST /api/historical-positions/import)

dry_run.description: Validate and count rows without writing

value.description: Pension, valuables and property only: what the holding is worth today in total, in the base currency. On a ticker of its own (a home, a car) it sets the price when the ticker has none, and must match the price it already has. On the base currency it must equal quantity

name: post_historical_positions_import
title: Post historical positions import
